name: tensordot
description: Representative ATen schema: aten::tensordot(Tensor self, Tensor other, int[] dims_self, int[] dims_other) -> Tensor. Contracts selected dimensions of two tensors. Tests cover explicit, negative, reordered and empty dimension lists, zero-size and size-one broadcast contractions, noncontiguous inputs, validation errors, unsupported dtypes, and gradients for both inputs.
